subject: history
concept: Recognizing a few significant people from the past and why they're remembered
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student listens to a short, age-appropriate story about a historical figure's notable action
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a historical figure to the simple reason they're remembered
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, why a described person from the past is still remembered today

misconception_flags: cannot connect the person to any specific reason they're remembered

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
